summary: Weight-for-height z-score is -4 when the height is outside the reference table
description:
calcWeightForHeightZscore returns -4 whenever the height is below 45 cm or above 110 cm, in both form engines (common-expression-helpers.ts in esm-form-engine-lib and js-expression-helper.ts in ngx-formentry). -4 means severe wasting, but here it only means the table has no row for that height. The weight-for-length tables cover 45 to 110 cm, so this affects:
children under 5 who are taller than 110 cm

children aged 5 and over, who have no weight-for-height reference, once they're taller than 110 cm

AMPATH's POC triage form hides the weight-for-height field when age>5, so a child aged exactly 5 who is taller than 110 cm still gets -4 saved to their encounter. I reproduced this in the Angular form engine with a 5-year-old girl at 112 cm.
Expected behaviour
The helper returns null (no z-score) when the height is outside the reference table or no weight-for-height reference applies to the child, rather than -4.

Both form engines behave the same.

Related: O3-6044
